plain_description: **Use OLMo to generate English text for language modeling and other applications.** The model is available for inference and fine-tuning. Check generated facts, as the README warns that they may be inaccurate.
technical_description: OLMo 7B is an autoregressive Transformer language model developed by the Allen Institute for AI and trained on the Dolma dataset. The README provides Hugging Face inference and fine-tuning instructions and describes model checkpoints and revisions. The code and model are released under Apache 2.0.
title: OLMo 7B
